headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a surprise win in the Bronx, defeating the New York Yankees 5-3 behind a strong pitching performance. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Jonatan Clase of the Toronto Blue Jays, who has been diagnosed with left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles have also placed Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Kansas City Royals have made several roster moves, including placing Bobby Witt Jr. on the 10-day injured list with low back tightness.

The Houston Astros have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade with the Kansas City Royals. The Los Angeles Dodgers have also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the New York Yankees 5-3, securing their win behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took a 2-0 lead in the game, ultimately securing a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, one RBI, and three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Clase Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left fielder Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, effective retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
